newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dora Maar, Picasso model and companion, dies at 89.
newsitem.headline: Dora Maar, Picasso model and companion, dies at 89.

text.p: Photographer and painter Dora Maar, who was a model and companion to Pablo Picasso, has died at the age of 89, Le Monde newspaper reported on Friday.
"I was only ever able to see, or imagine her, in tears," Picasso once said of Maar, whose real name was Theodora Markovic.
When he left her for Francoise Gilot, Maar suffered severe depression and was for a time interned for psychiatric treatment.
Le Monde said she died on July 16.
Born in France on November 22, 1907, she spent her youth in Argentina, and on her return posed as a model for photographers Henri Cartier-Bresson, Man Ray, and Germaine Krull.

Her own career as a photographer included trips to Barcelona in 1932 and London in 1934, as well as a series documenting the making of Picasso's harrowing painting Guernica on the bombing of a Basque Spanish town during Spain's 1936-1939 civil war.
